sections.title: Player win rates
sections.tldr: GRCX leads at 63.2%, ragnarneves trails at 36.8%, on 19 games. One standard error is about 11 points.

sections.title: Duo win rates
sections.tldr: Best pairing: GRCX + RikiPlancha12 at 80.0% (4-1). Worst: BabyGolem + ragnarneves at 20.0% (1-4). Every duo has few games, so none of this is settled.

sections.title: Champion win rates
sections.tldr: 60 distinct champions in 76 player-games. Best with >= 2 games: Dr. Mundo 100.0% (3-0), Kayle 100.0% (2-0), Lillia 100.0% (2-0).

sections.title: Tilt tracker
sections.tldr: After a loss: 40.6% (32 games). After a win: 59.4% (32 games). Losses are followed by more losses, but within sampling noise.

sections.title: Session fatigue
sections.tldr: 3 sessions, longest 10 games. Late-session samples are small and biased. Biggest drop from games 1-3 to 4+: ragnarneves (44.4% to 30.0%).

sections.title: Time of day
sections.tldr: 8 of 19 games began between 00:00 and 05:59.

sections.title: Game length buckets
sections.tldr: Short: 1 games, mid: 16, long: 2. Best in short games: GRCX (100.0%). Best in long games: RikiPlancha12 (100.0%).

sections.title: Stomp vs throw
sections.tldr: Average game 15:57; shortest 11:22 (won by GRCX + BabyGolem), longest 22:31 (won by GRCX + RikiPlancha12). Widest loss-vs-win length gap: BabyGolem (+135 s).

sections.title: Multikills
sections.tldr: GRCX leads with 17 multikills. Group: 36 doubles, 0 triples, 0 quadras, 0 pentas.

sections.title: First blood
sections.tldr: Teams with first blood won 63.2% (12-7); without it 36.8% (7-12). Most first-blood kills: GRCX (7).

sections.title: Combat profile
sections.tldr: Highest kill pace: GRCX (0.45/min). Highest death pace: BabyGolem (0.40/min), lowest: GRCX (0.37/min). Lowest damage per kill (kill-steal index): BabyGolem (4,252).

sections.title: Team share
sections.tldr: GRCX takes the largest damage share (56.1%); BabyGolem is the biggest punching bag (36,138 damage taken per game).

sections.title: Champion pool
sections.tldr: Widest pool: RikiPlancha12 (19 champions in 19 games). Narrowest: GRCX (favourite Kai'Sa x3).

sections.title: Liability index
sections.tldr: Highest deaths per minute: Vayne (0.49), then Kai'Sa (0.47), Kog'Maw (0.43). Min 2 games.

sections.title: Records

sections.title: Worst defeats
sections.tldr: Most deaths in a loss: BabyGolem on Shen, 11 deaths (61.1% of the team's deaths).

sections.title: Clean execution
sections.tldr: 0 deathless wins across 76 player-games.

sections.title: Time dead
sections.tldr: BabyGolem spends the most estimated time dead (19.5% of playtime). Dead time is estimated; alive time is exact.

sections.title: Augments
sections.tldr: 136 distinct augments picked. Best with >= 3 games: Final Form 100.0% (3-0), Symphony of War 100.0% (3-0), Escape Plan 80.0% (4-1). Worst: Bread and Cheese 0.0% (0-4), Transmute: Prismatic 0.0% (0-4), Eureka 25.0% (1-3).
